title: Nabbi w’ensozi eziyooleddwa
intro: Mu ddungu ery’amaanyi ery’omu Buwalabu obw’edda, waliwo ekifaananyi kyavaayo mu bantu abaali bamanyiddwa olw’obukugu bwabwe obw’ekitalo. Amaka gaabwe gaali gasituka okuva mu mayinja amagumu, naye emitima gyabwe gyali gikaluba okusinga ensozi ze baayoola. Omubaka ow’obwakatonda yatuuka n’akabonero kamu, ak’ekyamagero — naye amalala n’okujeemera byaviirako ebivaamu eby’amangu era eby’entiisa. Osobola okuzuula omuweereza ow’ekitiibwa abantu be gwe baalondawo okuzikirizibwa okusinga obulagirizi?
clues: Nasindikibwa ng’omulabuzi eri abantu bange, nga mbayita okusinza Katonda Omu.
Abantu bange baali babeera wakati mu mayinja ag’ekitalo, nga bayoola ebifo eby’okubeeramu eby’ekitalo mu nsozi.
Engamiya enkazi ey’ekyamagero yava mu lwazi olunywevu mu kusaba kwange, akabonero akategeerekeka okuva eri Omuyinza w’Ebintu Byonna.
Nagamba abantu bange amazzi bagabane n’engamiya eno enkazi so si kugikolako bulabe.
Abantu bange baakola olukwe okulwanyisa engamiya enkazi ne bagisala ebisambi, ne bassaako akabonero ku kuzikirizibwa kwabwe.
Musisi ow’entiisa yakuba abantu bange, ne basigala nga bagudde mu bifo mwe babeera nga tebatambula.
